Native reads ControlResistanceSet at 0xb80 and returns KnockbackMultiplier.GetCurrentValue(), or zero for a null set. Helper 0x14070cc00 is GetCurrentValue.

Iterates DecisionWindowStack at 0xbc0 in 0x18-byte records, returning ComboCounter at offset 0x68 of the first non-null DecisionWindow, or zero.
Stores the argument in ActiveContextSpecificHelpItem at 0x368 and broadcasts the no-argument OnContextHelpChanged delegate at 0x108 unconditionally.
Clears the out array and adds ActiveContextSpecificHelpItem at 0x368 if non-null.
